gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.
The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
I'm really looking forward to ___ you again soon.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: 'to' is a preposition here.

gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.
